items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I could have went up there and Lewis played with us.

ctx.x: bands. As I said, I played in some first class bands.

And I went away from here, I could have played in the Butterstock Band from Nashville, Mississippi, he used to play on Steamer Capital. He wanted me. I wanted to build up a home over there. And then Turt Johnson, the band, I don't know if he's from Baton Rouge, he wanted to fire his drum and take me. I was playing Jack Carey, I was playing Jack Carey, and my brother was playing bass, plays Brown. Then another place called, let me see, I believe it was Port Island, went to play. And there was a band up there…
But what is the difference between your brother's age and yours?
